E0765

The same parameter is labelled twice in one call (D-APILABEL1)

What

The same parameter is labelled twice in one call (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0765

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0765: tests/ui/arg_label_repeated.stderr.

Error [E0765]: `timeout:` is written twice in this call to `connect`
  --> tests/ui/arg_label_repeated.jet:3:52
    |
  3 | fn run() { _ :: connect("db.internal", timeout: 5, timeout: 10) }
    |                                                    ^^^^^^^
 Why: each parameter takes exactly one argument
 Fix: remove one of the `timeout:` arguments
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0765
